text.p: Credit Management Solutions Inc said Thursday it expects preliminary results for 1996 to show a revenue jump of over 35 percent to the range of $14 million, and despite heavy investment in new product areas during 1996, it believes it will report "positive earnings" for 1996.
The company reported 1995 net income of $957,932 on revenues of $10.2 million.
The company said it expects fourth quarter net income to exceed $200,000, but declined to elaborate. The company had 1995 fourth quarter net income of $49,000.
The company said it will officially release its 1996 earnings on Monday.
"To say anything more at this point would be premature," said Robert Vollono, the company's chief financial officer, in a telephone interview.
